_comment: Editable methodology. Drives the interactive TODO checklist in the UI. Check state is stored per-browser (localStorage), not on the server.

items: Confirm scope, in-scope hosts, and rules of engagement
Start an engagement log (host, time, action, result)
Start a listener before firing any shell (nc -lvnp)
Note your tun0/attack IP for LHOST
Full TCP port scan (nmap -p-)
Service/version + default scripts on open ports (-sV -sC)
Top UDP ports (nmap -sU --top-ports 100)
Map each service to an attack surface
Web: content discovery (gobuster/ffuf/feroxbuster) + nikto
SMB: nxc smb --shares / enum4linux-ng / smbclient
DNS/SNMP where present
Identify the weakest service / known CVE
Pick a reverse-shell template matching what the target runs
Deliver payload (URL-encode for web params, base64 for PowerShell)
Catch the shell on your listener
Upgrade to a TTY (python pty + stty raw -echo; fg)
export TERM=xterm and set rows/columns
Confirm user, hostname, OS, arch, network position
Run linpeas / winpeas
Linux: sudo -l, SUID, capabilities, cron, writable paths (GTFOBins)
Windows: whoami /priv, services, scheduled tasks, systeminfo -> missing patches
Escalate to root / SYSTEM
Find DCs (DNS SRV / port scan 88,389,445)
Null/guest enum (nxc smb --null-session, rpcclient, enum4linux-ng)
Harvest usernames (kerbrute userenum)
Responder poisoning -> crack NetNTLMv2 (hashcat -m 5600)
AS-REP roast accounts without pre-auth
Read the password policy BEFORE spraying
Validate + find local admin (nxc smb -> Pwn3d!)
Spray carefully (kerbrute / nxc), stay under lockout
Kerberoast (GetUserSPNs / nxc ldap --kerberoasting)
Collect BloodHound graph, find paths to DA
Get a shell (evil-winrm / psexec / wmiexec)
Dump local creds where admin (nxc smb --sam --lsa / secretsdump)
Reuse creds/hashes laterally (pass-the-hash)
DCSync with replication rights (nxc smb --ntds / secretsdump -just-dc)
krbtgt -> golden ticket (only if authorized)
Document every credential, path, and host owned
Identify reachable internal hosts/subnets
Set up tunneling (chisel / ssh -D) as scope allows
Re-run recon from the new vantage point
Collect required proof; note cleanup (files, listeners, artifacts)
Grab the flag: local.txt / proof.txt (and root/Administrator proof)
Screenshot the flag next to whoami/id (Linux) or whoami (Windows)
Screenshot ip a / ipconfig on the target showing its IP
Record the exact exploitation steps + commands while they're fresh
Save every credential, hash, and ticket obtained (with source host)
Note the IP/host each proof came from — don't mix targets
Write each finding: affected host, steps to reproduce, impact
Confirm all screenshots are legible and flags match the target IP
List artifacts left on targets (uploads, shells, listeners) for cleanup
Cross-check every in-scope host was attempted before time runs out
